_comment: CIVILIAN kit: the REGISTRY MARK - a cobalt double pinstripe running lengthwise past a pale maker's plate with three dark glyph bars. Paint-flat like the industrial hazard band, and for the same reason: a marking is a DECAL, so it lies on any seat a thin build offers - this is the kit's cone-friendly thin-shape carrier. The fiction is 'designed, sold, INSURED': every hull that left a yard carries its registration somewhere, which is why the rule floors one per block rather than scattering many. Raises its footprint budget: paint cannot collide with anything and a pinstripe wants length.
